parameters.name: X-Step-Up-Token

put.summary:
Saves one key. A stale `rowVersion` is `409 STALE_VERSION` with `current { rowVersion,
updatedBy, updatedAt, value }` (a `payment` value shows only `accountNumberLast5`). Field errors
carry the full camelCase path, for example `ordering.boardThresholds.accept.warn`. The
`payment` key also needs `X-Step-Up-Token` for `settings.payment` (`403 FORBIDDEN` without it),
and the other admins are emailed after the save.

post.summary:
`STAFF`: `200 AdminSession` and the cookie. `MANAGER` and `ADMIN`: `403 MFA_REQUIRED` with
`mfaToken`, `mfaEnrolled` and `expiresIn` (api-divergences D-076), no cookie. Unknown email,
wrong password, locked, `INVITED`, `DELETED`, no password and a customer account: the same
`401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`; `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` only after the right password.
Revokes the cookie's family and clears the cookie; `204` whether or not a session existed.

The second step of a `MANAGER` or `ADMIN` (A3-T2): the challenge (`mfaToken` of
`MFA_REQUIRED`) with a TOTP `code` or one `recoveryCode`. Success: `200` with the session and
`recoveryCodesLeft`, and the cookie. Invalid or expired challenge, or an account that may no
longer sign in: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. Wrong, replayed or locked-out code: `400 CODE_INVALID`
(counted toward the lockout; brief E15).

202.description: The same answer whether or not the email has an account.

post.summary:
`202` whatever happened: a reset link to an `ACTIVE` staff account, a fresh invitation to an
`INVITED` one, nothing otherwise (decision 0008 section 5; api-divergences D-084).
Sets the password from an invitation or reset link; `CODE_INVALID` for any dead link.

Rotates the cookie (reuse detection, 10-second grace window). Any failure answers
`401 UNAUTHENTICATED` and clears the cookie.

A current TOTP code (not a recovery code) and a `purpose`: `200` with a step-up token valid 5
minutes for that purpose. Wrong, replayed (a step already used, for example by
the sign-in a moment ago: wait for the next code) or locked-out code: `400 CODE_INVALID`,
counted toward the lockout. No confirmed second factor: `409 MFA_NOT_ENABLED`.

Soft delete. Deleting the default chooses no other one (mobile G101); there is no restore, the
app holds the call for "Hoàn tác" (mobile G100).

Links a Google or Apple account (`{ idToken, nonce }` from the native flow and
`POST /auth/social/nonce`). Customers only; linking the same account again is a no-op.

200.description: With the enrolment token, also sets the kd_refresh cookie.

post.summary:
Confirms the pending secret with a current code and returns ten recovery codes, shown once.
With the enrolment token the sign-in completes: `session` and the `kd_refresh` cookie (decision
0008 section 8). A wrong, replayed or locked-out code is `400 CODE_INVALID`.

Replaces the whole recovery set after a current TOTP code; the old codes stop working. No
confirmed second factor: `409 MFA_NOT_ENABLED`.

A new secret, pending until `confirm`: `200 { otpauthUri, secret }`, shown once. An enabled
second factor is never replaced here: `409 ALREADY_EXISTS`.
Keeps the current session; every other session of the user is signed out.
